{{Quote|The pilot whose route I am presently flying has retired.|Blink, reporting Tohrm's death in code to Ackmena|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Tohrm''' was a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] member of [[Freedom Flight]], an anti-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization. Serving as one of the organization's [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who helped people escape slavery and start new lives, he came into contact with the enslaved [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kitaya Shuul]] and fellow Freedom Flight members [[Blink]] and [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]]. By [[44 ABY]], Tohrm was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an organization opposed to Freedom Flight. Following his death, Blink took over his shipment of people who had escaped slavery and reported his death to Ackmena on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'd hoped he had found another company to do business with.|Ackmena, after hearing about Tohrm's death|<ref name="Allies" />}}
[[File:Ackmena1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The bartender Ackmena, one of Tohrm's contacts]]
The [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] Tohrm was an active member of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide anti-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization known as [[Freedom Flight]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Within Freedom Flight, Tohrm served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who helped enslaved individuals escape from their servitude and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] them elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to establish new lives with new identities. He was a contact of the enslaved [[Human/Legends|Human]] aspiring Freedom Flight member [[Kitaya Shuul]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], as well as at least two other Freedom Flight members, including a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] nicknamed "[[Blink]]" and the Human [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]].<ref name="Allies" />

By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Tohrm was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by one of the organizations opposing Freedom Flight. When he did not make his usual stops at Tatooine, both Shuul and Ackmena became worried; Shuul assumed that visits for Tohrm had become too risky and he was being forced to lie low. However, Blink soon met with Ackmena in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] on Tatooine and reported Tohrm's death while speaking in code, adding that he had taken over Tohrm's shipment of slavery escapees. Shuul overheard the conversation and was saddened by the news of Tohrm's death. When Shuul later introduced herself to Blink, she mentioned Tohrm's name to prove she was an ally of Freedom Flight.<ref name="Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I hope you'll be as careful with the shipment of Tedonian wine as Tohrm was.|Ackmena, speaking in code to Blink|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Tohrm was opposed to slavery, joining the Freedom Flight as a pilot and becoming an active member of the organization, ferrying enslaved individuals to safety. Ackmena believed that Tohrm was very careful with his shipments of slavery escapees.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tohrm was mentioned in [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2010]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', the fifth installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Allies" />
